Description (SPA): Identificador sustituto de la fila de cruce.
Description (ENG): Surrogate identifier for the crosswalk row.
Notes: The natural uniqueness rule is election_id plus state name key and source municipality ID when available.

Description (SPA): Eleccion a la que corresponde el municipio fuente.
Description (ENG): Election contest to which the source municipality belongs.
Notes: A municipio may have a different source representation in each election cycle.
Used together with municipio_key because municipio names repeat across states.

Description (SPA): Identificador municipal crudo proporcionado por INE cuando existe.
Description (ENG): Raw municipal identifier supplied by INE when available.
Notes: It is retained for audit and duplicate-name disambiguation; it is not assumed to be INEGI CVE_MUN.

Description (SPA): Nombre de municipio en los resultados electorales.
Description (ENG): Municipality name in the electoral results.
Notes: The historical spelling is intentionally preserved.

Description (SPA): Nombre normalizado sin acentos ni puntuacion.
Description (ENG): Normalized name without accents or punctuation.
Notes: Used for exact state/name matching and manual overrides.

Description (SPA): Clave INEGI de cinco digitos del municipio resuelto.
Notes: Only populated for exact name matches or manual overrides.

Description (SPA): Identificador de la feature GeoJSON usada en el mapa.
Description (ENG): GeoJSON feature identifier used by the map.
Values / Domain: Same value as inegi_cvegeo or NULL.
Notes: Kept explicitly so map joins are inspectable.

Description (SPA): Metodo usado para resolver la clave de mapa.
Description (ENG): Method used to resolve the map key.
Notes: Fuzzy suggestions are never automatically assigned.

Description (SPA): Estado de revision para nombres no resueltos o ambiguos.
Description (ENG): Review status for unresolved or ambiguous names.
Notes: Consult suggested fields and the materialized review CSV before adding an override.

Description (SPA): Mejor sugerencia por similitud de nombre.
Nombre INEGI asociado a la sugerencia.
Description (ENG): INEGI name associated with the suggestion.

Notes: For review prioritization only; not a confidence guarantee.
